product_desc: raw minced pork filling a plain black tray, coarse texture with clearly visible white fat through the lean, the tray bare and unlabelled with no text or barcode anywhere on it
cook: a mother in her forties, apron over a plain shirt, hair tied back, warm and practical
kitchen: a warm Chinese home kitchen, wood cabinets, a gas wok range, a rice cooker on the counter, soft afternoon light
prep_subject: long purple Chinese eggplant cut into thick batons about six centimetres long, their cut faces pale cream and slightly porous, arranged on a wooden board. Beside them the raw minced pork on a white plate, plus chopped garlic, ginger and cut spring onion. A knife rests flat at the far side of the board
prep_defines: the eggplant baton size and the coarse texture of the mince
cook_vessel: a carbon steel wok over a blue gas flame
cook_subject: the minced pork browning in the wok and breaking into loose crumbs, the eggplant batons added and softening, their edges turning translucent and golden as they absorb the dark savoury sauce. The sauce is thick and clings rather than pooling
cook_negatives: grey unbrowned mince, eggplant collapsing into mush, thin watery sauce, tomato sauce colour, western ratatouille, deep-fried eggplant in batter
hero_subject: the finished dish in a shallow ceramic bowl, soft golden eggplant batons coated in dark glossy sauce with browned minced pork throughout, chopped spring onion green scattered on top
hero_setting: a warm home dining table, a bowl of steamed rice beside, soft evening light
story: mince browns, eggplant softens in the sauce
negatives_global: ratatouille, tomato sauce, cheese, deep-fried battered eggplant, mushy collapsed eggplant, grey unbrowned mince
first_heat: The minced pork hits the wok and spreads out, breaking into loose crumbs as it starts to brown, fat rendering out and steam lifting from the metal.
transform: the mince browns from pale pink to deep golden, the eggplant batons go in and soften visibly, their cut faces turning translucent and golden as they drink up the dark sauce, which thickens and clings.
lift: A wooden spatula enters from the left, lifts one eggplant baton coated in sauce and browned mince clear of the wok, and holds it at the centre of frame while sauce runs off it slowly.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame holding the wok, tip it once over the bowl, and the eggplant and mince slide out together with the thick sauce following slowly. The hands withdraw out of frame.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right holding chopsticks, takes one soft eggplant baton, lifts it clear of the bowl and holds it steady at the centre of frame, sauce and mince clinging to it.
sound_01: A warm home kitchen with a low room tone and a rice cooker ticking quietly. In the first shot, a tray set down on a wooden counter. In the second shot, cut eggplant shifting on a board. In the third shot, a gas burner rising, then the dense sizzle of mince meeting hot metal. No speech.
sound_02: A steady frying sound throughout, the scrape of a wooden spatula, then a softer wetter bubbling as the eggplant releases moisture and the sauce thickens. No speech.
sound_03: A quiet home. In the first shot, soft eggplant and thick sauce sliding into a ceramic bowl. In the second shot, chopped spring onion landing. In the third shot, chopsticks lifting a soft baton, and a rice bowl set down on wood. No speech.
music: A warm maternal bed: piano over low strings, slow and unhurried, the feeling of an ordinary weeknight dinner.
